class.name: OcgXcafdocLayertool
class.brief_description: Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (Layers) of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document A Document is intended to hold different attributes of ONE shape and it's sub-shapes Provide tools for management of Layers section of document.
class.description: ! Provides tools to store and retrieve attributes (Layers) ! of TopoDS_Shape in and from TDocStd_Document ! A Document is intended to hold different ! attributes of ONE shape and it's sub-shapes ! Provide tools for management of Layers section of document.

method.name: BaseLabel
method.description: returns the label under which Layers are stored

method.name: ShapeTool
method.description: Returns internal XCAFDoc_ShapeTool tool

method.name: IsLayer
method.description: Returns True if label belongs to a Layertable and is a Layer definition

method.name: FindLayer_1
method.description: Finds a Layer definition in a Layertable and returns its label if found Returns False if Layer is not found in Layertable

method.name: FindLayer_2
method.description: Finds a Layer definition in a Layertable by name Returns first founded label with the same name if <theToFindWithProperty> is false If <theToFindWithProperty> is true returns first label that contains or not contains visible attr, according to the <theToFindVisible> parameter

method.name: AddLayer_1
method.description: Adds a Layer definition to a Layertable and returns its label (returns existing label if the same Layer is already defined)

method.name: AddLayer_2
method.description: Adds a Layer definition to a Layertable and returns its label Returns existing label (if it is already defined) of visible or invisible layer, according to <theToFindVisible> parameter

method.name: RemoveLayer
method.description: Removes Layer from the Layertable

method.name: GetLayerLabels
method.description: Returns a sequence of Layers currently stored in the Layertable

method.name: SetLayer_1
method.description: Sets a link from label <L> to Layer defined by <LayerL> optional parameter <shapeInOneLayer> show could shape be in number of layers or only in one.

method.name: SetLayer_2
method.description: Sets a link from label <L> to Layer <aLayer> in the Layertable Adds a Layer as necessary optional parameter <shapeInOneLayer> show could shape be in number of layers or only in one.

method.name: UnSetLayers_1
method.description: Removes a link from label <L> to all layers

method.name: UnSetOneLayer_1
method.description: Remove link from label <L> and Layer <aLayer>. returns FALSE if no such layer.

method.name: UnSetOneLayer_2
method.description: Remove link from label <L> and Layer <aLayerL>. returns FALSE if <aLayerL> is not a layer label.

method.name: IsSet_1
method.description: Returns True if label <L> has a Layer associated with the <aLayer>.

method.name: IsSet_2
method.description: Returns True if label <L> has a Layer associated with the <aLayerL> label.

method.name: IsVisible
method.description: Return TRUE if layer is visible, FALSE if invisible.

method.name: SetVisibility
method.description: Set the visibility of layer. If layer is invisible when on it's layer will set UAttribute with corresponding GUID.

method.name: SetLayer_3
method.description: Sets a link from label that containing shape <Sh> with layer that situated at label <LayerL>. optional parameter <shapeInOneLayer> show could shape be in number of layers or only in one. return FALSE if no such shape <Sh> or label <LayerL>

method.name: SetLayer_4
method.description: Sets a link from label that containing shape <Sh> with layer <aLayer>. Add <aLayer> to LayerTable if nessesery. optional parameter <shapeInOneLayer> show could shape be in number of layers or only in one. return FALSE if no such shape <Sh>.

method.name: UnSetLayers_2
method.description: Remove link between shape <Sh> and all Layers at LayerTable. return FALSE if no such shape <Sh> in XCAF Document.

method.name: UnSetOneLayer_3
method.description: Remove link between shape <Sh> and layer <aLayer>. returns FALSE if no such layer <aLayer> or shape <Sh>.

method.name: UnSetOneLayer_4
method.description: Remove link between shape <Sh> and layer <aLayerL>. returns FALSE if no such layer <aLayerL> or shape <Sh>.

method.name: IsSet_3
method.description: Returns True if shape <Sh> has a Layer associated with the <aLayer>.

method.name: IsSet_4
method.description: Returns True if shape <Sh> has a Layer associated with the <aLayerL>.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Set
method.description: Creates (if not exist) LayerTool.

method.name: GetShapesOfLayer
method.description: Return sequanese of shape labels that assigned with layers to <ShLabels>.
